correctness.rationale: With q=s/p, direct differentiation of x+qy cancels the Holling-III terms exactly. Periodicity gives the mean identity. The symbolic checker verifies the cancellation, stationary point, and quadratic root. No numerical experiment is used as proof.

value.rationale: The result turns the source's difficult nonlinear interaction into a directly checkable necessary harvest budget, complementing its existence theorem with a nonexistence certificate. It removes the half-saturation coefficient from the ceiling and provides an explicit predator-mean bound. The varying q=s/p formulation is structurally motivated by the source's separate consumption and conversion coefficients and contains the fixed-ratio case as a natural corollary.
